svg.text: v0.2 charm pass · a swimming crab (Portunidae) with a stone-crab crusher and long-eyed stalks · 10 legs: 2 claws + 6 walking legs + 2 swimming paddles
R = the crab’s own right (screen left in front view) · crusher on R, cutter on L
in-game camera sees the FRONT: a crab walks sideways across the screen
No face muscles: emotion is carried by the eyestalks, antennae, claws and how high the body rides on its legs.
4 · MOVEMENT · a heavy tank: momentum, wind-up, weight
Walk: diagonal sets alternate (L1+L3+R2, then R1+R3+L2) while the claws stay off the ground. Gait timing from Barnes 1975 (Uca), adapted for paddles held up: see notes.
5 · COMBAT · guard, timed parry, crusher combo, counter
Crusher (right claw) swings to screen-left: slow, crushing. Cutter (left) is the quick jab to screen-right. Every hit starts with a readable wind-up.
Lantern: a jar culture of yellow-glowing Vibrio-type bacteria (a real yellow strain exists). Helmet held by hooked setae like a decorator crab. Shield gripped like a boxer crab’s anemone.
Downscaled from the painted hero as the game would show it, plus flat silhouettes.
flat silhouettes · idle at 160 / 80 px, then idle, threat, guard, paddle-jump at 40 px
Warm = crab, home, lantern. Cold teal → black = the deep.
Violet / cyan = wild bioluminescence. Our lantern is the
only warm light in the deep, so the player reads it instantly.
eye on a stalk · folds into its orbit
CUTTER (left claw): slimmer · only the dactyl moves
1 · MAIN IN-GAME VIEW (front: what the camera sees as the crab walks sideways)
Low, wide, planted. Heavy crusher rests low like a fist; the slim cutter is held up, ready. Paddles (5th legs) held up over the back.
no tail: abdomen folded under · 9 anterolateral teeth each side
crab’s right flank: near legs fan ) | ( toward us, far legs behind
paddles nearest · abdomen fold just visible
eyes cocked at different angles, antennae forward, cutter lifted
eyes folded into the orbits, claws tucked over the face, body dropped
up on its legs, claws raised and spread wide, fingers gaping
settled low, claws folded, eyes relaxed outward, lantern hung
belly on the sand, claws dragging, eyes half-folded
claws up in front as a shield
costs a claw: no cutter jab while carried
bottle-cap helmet · amber sea-glass shield · lantern hung from a setae hook
PROPS (crab scale: cap ≈ ⅓ carapace width)
jar + bottle-cap lid + fishing-line bail · crown cap · sea glass
pale, cautious; hardens over ~1 day (paper → buckram)
lost crusher returns small and slender; grows back over moults
camouflage: no red light reaches here (NOAA)
